name: Artifacts
reason: 48 vanilla-style exploration trinkets found in chests and Mimics; gives dungeons the rare-loot moment the brief asks for without touching stats systems.
notes: Works with Curios or Accessories; Curios is present (required by Cataclysm). mods.toml declares neither, so keep Curios installed.

name: Aquamirae
reason: Frozen-ocean horror: Ice Maze, pirate ships, Captain Cornelia and the Maze Mother; gives the ocean a dark-fantasy chapter.
notes: 7.x moved from Obscure API to Fragmentum (which jar-in-jars Kotlin for Forge and YACL). The Ice Maze is a frozen-ocean feature, track it via the advancement. Bosses are not in c:bosses.

name: Born in Chaos
reason: Dark-fantasy/horror bestiary (86 entities, dark towers, graves) with a real boss (Lord Pumpkinhead) and several mini-bosses that appear from night 10; strongest tonal fit in the mob layer.
conflicts: Spawn pressure stacks with RPG Mobs' level scaling; review spawn weights (Born In Configuration / In Control) during balancing.
notes: Mod id born_in_chaos_v1. Lord Pumpkinhead is summoned by using Transmuting Elixir on an Infernal Evil Pumpkin; Sir Pumpkinhead appears 25 Oct-5 Nov. Bosses are NOT in c:bosses - add them via datapack so RPG Mobs treats them as bosses.

name: Bosses of Mass Destruction (Forge/NeoForge)
reason: Four structure-bound bosses (Night Lich, Obsidilith, Gauntlet, Void Blossom) that give natural exploration goals across Overworld/Nether/End; NeoForge port of the Fabric original.
notes: 'lich' here is the Night Lich; The Graveyard also has a graveyard:lich - name quests carefully.

name: Bosses'Rise
reason: 'Epic souls-like boss fights' by Block Factory: five arena bosses (Underworld Knight, Infernal Dragon, Yeti, Sandworm, Kraken) behind keys; fits a soulslike exactly.
notes: Mod id is block_factorys_bosses (not bossesrise). All Rights Reserved; distribute via platform API only.

name: Deeper and Darker
reason: Endgame descent below the Ancient City into the Otherside dimension with Warden-tier gear; dark, compact, vanilla-styled.
notes: Runeborn already pays a relic for the Warden - Deeper and Darker extends that kill into the Otherside chapter.

name: Friends&Foes (Forge/NeoForge)
reason: Vanilla-style mob-vote creatures (Copper/Tuff Golem, Glare, Iceologer, Illusioner, Mauler, Wildfire mini-boss) - the 'vanilla-first' backbone of the bestiary.
conflicts: Both Friends&Foes and Illager Invasion re-enable and restyle the vanilla Illusioner and add Illusioner structures (shack/training grounds vs tower). Pick one owner: disable F&F's Illusioner in its config. Licence CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0.

name: Guard Villagers
reason: Village guards defend settlements against levelled raids and night spawns; complements (does not replace) Fellowship's hired warband.
notes: Entity guardvillagers:guard. Guards are village NPCs, not party members - no overlap with Fellowship's command wheel.

name: Illager Invasion
reason: Port of Illager Expansion: 10 new illagers, an Invoker boss, Illager Fort and Illusioner Tower - deepens the raid/illager questline.
notes: extensibleenums (Fuzs) is jar-in-jar inside Illager Invasion; no separate download. Its structure id illagerinvasion:labyrinth is unrelated to NightBeam's labyrinth dungeons.

name: L_Ender's Cataclysm
reason: The flagship boss mod: 8 tagged bosses with dedicated arenas and signature gear; perfect chapter bosses between Runeborn's Sovereigns and the Eclipsed Realm.
conflicts: Its bosses carry the c:bosses tag; confirm NightBeam RPG Mobs reads that tag so they show a level but are not rank-rolled.
notes: Mini-bosses: cataclysm:ender_golem, ignited_revenant, clawdian, coralssus, the_prowler, kobolediator, aptrgangr, wadjet. Licence CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0 (pack redistribution via platform API only).

name: Mowzie's Mobs
reason: Hand-animated, telegraphed bosses (Ferrous Wroughtnaut, Frostmaw, Umvuthi, Sculptor) that suit soulslike pattern-learning, plus useful relic gear.
notes: naga is a mini-boss (not in c:bosses). Custom licence (Mowzie's Mobs License) - check its modpack clause before publishing.

name: Naturalist
reason: Vanilla-style wildlife (bears, deer, boars, snakes, alligators...) that makes the overworld feel alive and gives hunting quests; low performance cost.
notes: Quest hook entities: naturalist:bear, naturalist:deer, naturalist:boar, naturalist:alligator, naturalist:komodo_dragon, naturalist:great_white_shark.

name: The Graveyard (Fabric/NeoForge)
reason: Graveyards, crypts, haunted houses and overrun villages with ghouls, revenants, wraiths and the Lich boss - the most on-tone structure+mob pack for 'Remnants'.
notes: Mod id graveyard. 4.0.1 (2026-10-27) newly requires Villager Trading Plus [1.1.0,2); CurseForge's newest VTP 1.21.1 file is 1.1 (2024-09) - use Modrinth 1.1.1 or pin Graveyard to the previous build if CF resolution fails.

name: Better Combat
reason: The standard animated melee layer (combos, swing arcs, two-handed/dual wield). Ships presets for katana, claymore, twin_blade, scythe, halberd, spear, etc. Cataclysm, Born in Chaos, Aquamirae, Bosses'Rise and Simply Swords already ship weapon_attributes for it.
conflicts: Hard-incompatible with Epic Fight. Runeborn 3.0 ships NO Better Combat weapon_attributes (verified in the jar), so Runeborn's 74 armaments keep vanilla swings unless the pack adds a datapack mapping each Runeborn class to a BC preset (dagger->bettercombat:dagger, katana->katana, greatsword->claymore, colossal sword/great hammer->heavy_axe/hammer, twinblade->twin_blade, reaper->scythe, spear->spear, halberd->halberd, fist->fist, claws->claw, staff->staff). Must be play-tested against Runeborn's per-attack stamina cost.

name: Handcrafted
reason: Furniture for player bases and taverns in vanilla style; one decor mod instead of a decor suite.

name: Dungeons and Taverns
reason: Nova's vanilla-style structures: taverns, Illager manor, combat shrines (5 tiers), crypts, End castle and - fittingly - 'remnant_*' ruined settlements; ships advancements usable as quest tasks.
conflicts: Its minecraft:village_taiga override interacts with Towns and Towers' village tags; its witch_villa / mangrove_witch_hut add more witch content next to NightBeam's The Witch Hut (fine, but avoid 'find the witch hut' quests that match the wrong one).
notes: Mod id mr_dungeons_andtaverns, lang namespace dnt, structure namespace nova_structures. Newest NeoForge 1.21.1 file is v4.4.4 (2024-09); 25 MB. Overrides the vanilla taiga village and several vanilla mansion/archaeology loot tables and adds custom enchantments (nova_structures:*).

name: Explorer's Compass
reason: Lets players (and quest rewards) locate any structure by id - the bridge between quests and the ~300 structure ids above.
notes: Licence CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0. Blacklist boss arenas you want discovered organically.

name: Nature's Compass
reason: Biome locator for biome-gated quests (Terralith adds 130 biomes).

name: Nullscape
reason: Turns the End into alien terrain while keeping it desolate; makes the End chapter (Cataclysm Ender Guardian, BOMD Void Blossom/Obsidilith) worth travelling.
conflicts: Not compatible with most End worldgen mods (except Better End); works with YUNG's Better End Island on 1.19+. Must be in the world from creation.

name: Philip's Ruins
reason: Ruins, crypts and the 'Lost Soul City' with loot - more 'remnants' scenery and early loot; light.
notes: Only one NeoForge 1.21.1 build (2.0, 2025-01).

name: Sparse Structures
reason: One config to space out every structure set (incl. modded) - essential with ~10 structure mods; /dumpstructuresets helps per-structure tuning.
notes: Server-side only; config sparsestructures.json5, restart to reload.

name: Structory
reason: Small atmospheric ruins, chapels, graveyards and outcast villagers - 'remnants of the old world' scenery that suits the pack name; datapack-style, cheap.
notes: Newest file is named Structory_26.2_v1.3.7.jar but its Modrinth version 1.3.17 declares 1.21-1.21.11 (multi-version overlay jar). If anything misbehaves pin 1.3.14 (Structory_1.21.x_v1.3.14.jar).

name: Tectonic
reason: Terrain shaping; the mod ships a dedicated Terralith-compatible variant, so the two are designed to be paired.
notes: Jar-in-jars ApolLib 1.1.6.

name: Terralith
reason: Vanilla-block biome overhaul (130 biomes, 28 small structures) - the 'vanilla-first' choice; no new wood/block palette.
notes: 1.21.1 NeoForge build 2.6.2 is NeoForge-specific and requires Lithostitched. Contains terralith:witch_hut + underground/witch_hut (see The Witch Hut note).

name: Towns and Towers
reason: Biome-specific villages and pillager outposts (60 variants) - vanilla-first settlement variety for villages, Guard Villagers and Fellowship hiring (sellswords spawn near village bells).

name: When Dungeons Arise
reason: Large hand-built roguelike dungeons (Illager Fort, Plague Asylum, Thornborn Towers, Heavenly Conqueror, Keep Kayra) - the 2-8 player co-op set pieces the brief asks for.
notes: Big structures: tune spacing with Sparse Structures. All Rights Reserved; platform distribution only.

name: YUNG's Better Desert Temples
reason: Puzzle temple with traps and a Pharaoh's chamber; strong early-game quest target.
notes: CurseForge project exists, but cfwidget's file list shows no NeoForge 1.21.1 file (its listing is partial for this project); resolve the CF file id in the CurseForge app/API or use the Modrinth file.

name: YUNG's Better Dungeons
reason: Replaces vanilla spawner rooms with skeleton/zombie/spider dungeons and small catacombs - early-game dungeons that complement NightBeam's Much More Dungeons labyrinths.
notes: CurseForge project exists, but cfwidget's file list shows no NeoForge 1.21.1 file (its listing is partial for this project); resolve the CF file id in the CurseForge app/API or use the Modrinth file.

name: YUNG's Better End Island
reason: Reworked dragon fight arena; the Ender Dragon pays a Runeborn crown shard, so the fight deserves an upgrade.
notes: CurseForge project exists, but cfwidget's file list shows no NeoForge 1.21.1 file (its listing is partial for this project); resolve the CF file id in the CurseForge app/API or use the Modrinth file.

name: YUNG's Better Jungle Temples
reason: Expanded jungle temple with puzzles and traps.
notes: CurseForge project exists, but cfwidget's file list shows no NeoForge 1.21.1 file (its listing is partial for this project); resolve the CF file id in the CurseForge app/API or use the Modrinth file.

name: YUNG's Better Mineshafts
reason: Biome-themed mineshafts; pure vanilla-plus.
notes: CurseForge project exists, but cfwidget's file list shows no NeoForge 1.21.1 file (its listing is partial for this project); resolve the CF file id in the CurseForge app/API or use the Modrinth file.

name: YUNG's Better Nether Fortresses
reason: Reworked fortress; the Nether chapter's main dungeon if Incendium stays off.
notes: CurseForge project exists, but cfwidget's file list shows no NeoForge 1.21.1 file (its listing is partial for this project); resolve the CF file id in the CurseForge app/API or use the Modrinth file.

name: YUNG's Better Ocean Monuments
reason: Bigger monument; the Elder Guardian already pays a Runeborn relic.
notes: CurseForge project exists, but cfwidget's file list shows no NeoForge 1.21.1 file (its listing is partial for this project); resolve the CF file id in the CurseForge app/API or use the Modrinth file.

name: YUNG's Better Strongholds
reason: Turns the stronghold into a proper multi-hour dungeon before the End chapter.
notes: CurseForge project exists, but cfwidget's file list shows no NeoForge 1.21.1 file (its listing is partial for this project); resolve the CF file id in the CurseForge app/API or use the Modrinth file.

name: YUNG's Bridges
reason: Bridges over rivers; makes long overland travel (horses) smoother.
notes: CurseForge project exists, but cfwidget's file list shows no NeoForge 1.21.1 file (its listing is partial for this project); resolve the CF file id in the CurseForge app/API or use the Modrinth file.

name: YUNG's Extras
reason: Small vanilla-style decorations (wells, ruins); harmless flavour.
notes: CurseForge project exists, but cfwidget's file list shows no NeoForge 1.21.1 file (its listing is partial for this project); resolve the CF file id in the CurseForge app/API or use the Modrinth file.

name: Amendments
reason: Companion to Supplementaries that improves vanilla blocks (lanterns, cauldrons, skulls); no new progression.

name: Brewin' And Chewin'
reason: Keg brewing (mead, ales) and cheeses - feeds the tavern fantasy that D&T/WDA taverns and Fellowship sellswords set up.
notes: Jar-in-jars GreenhouseConfig. Modrinth lists no deps but mods.toml requires farmersdelight [1.3.2,).

name: Farmer's Delight
reason: The expected cooking layer: knives, cooking pot, meals with Comfort/Nourishment buffs that matter in long boss fights; the de-facto standard food mod with a huge addon ecosystem.
conflicts: No NightBeam clash: the NightBeam audit excludes Sprout & Soil (unfinished on 1.21.1); Better Farming ++ (optional there) only overlaps in right-click harvesting.

name: Supplementaries
reason: Vanilla+ utility/decor (quivers, sacks, globes, antique ink, signposts) that gives quests tangible items; also adds the road_sign and galleon structures.
notes: Jar-in-jars MixinSquared and Sable companion. Declares Farmer's Delight <1.3.0 incompatible (we ship 1.3.4).

name: Horseman
reason: Makes horses a real travel option (hitching, smooth riding, horse inventory switch) for long distance-scaled journeys; MIT, lightweight.

name: CERBON's API
reason: Required by Bosses of Mass Destruction.

name: Cloth Config API
reason: Config library required by Better Combat, Bosses of Mass Destruction and Cristel Lib.

name: Cristel Lib
reason: Required by Towns and Towers (Cristel Lib declares t_and_t <=1.13.3 incompatible; we use 1.13.11).

name: Curios API
reason: Accessory-slot API; required by Cataclysm and used by Artifacts (and Iron's Spells if enabled).

name: Fragmentum
reason: Obscuria library required by Aquamirae 7.x (replaces Obscure API); bundles Kotlin for Forge 5.3.0 and YACL 3.6.6.

name: Geckolib
reason: Animation library for Mowzie's, Bosses'Rise, BOMD, Born in Chaos, Aquamirae, The Graveyard (and NightBeam's Eclipsed Realm / Skills and Powers).

name: Lionfish-API
reason: Required by L_Ender's Cataclysm (versionRange 3.1).

name: Lithostitched
reason: Worldgen library required by Terralith and Tectonic (jar-in-jars ApolLib).

name: Moonlight Lib
reason: Moonlight Lib, required by Supplementaries and Amendments.

name: playerAnimator
reason: Animation library required by Better Combat (and by NightBeam's Skills and Powers and Iron's Spells). Only beta builds exist for 1.21.1.
notes: Modrinth release channel for the newest NeoForge 1.21.1 build: beta. Newest 1.21.1 NeoForge build is a beta (2.0.4).

name: Puzzles Lib
reason: Fuzs library required by Illager Invasion (and Mutant Monsters if enabled).

name: Resourceful Lib
reason: Required by Friends&Foes and Handcrafted (and It Takes a Pillage if enabled).

name: Villager Trading Plus
reason: Required by The Graveyard 4.x (version range [1.1.0,2)).

name: YUNG's API
reason: Required by every YUNG's mod.
notes: CurseForge project exists, but cfwidget's file list shows no NeoForge 1.21.1 file (its listing is partial for this project); resolve the CF file id in the CurseForge app/API or use the Modrinth file.

name: Serene Seasons
reason: Seasons affect crop growth and colours; harmless but adds farming friction - optional.
notes: Modrinth release channel for the newest NeoForge 1.21.1 build: beta. Release channel beta.

name: Critters and Companions
reason: Cute ambient critters (otters, red pandas, ferrets); good quality but off-tone for dark fantasy.

name: It Takes a Pillage Continuation
reason: Illager bastilles/camps and new pillager troops; overlaps Illager Invasion + Dungeons and Taverns illager structures - only if the illager arc needs more.

name: Mutant Monsters
reason: Mutant Zombie/Skeleton/Creeper/Enderman mini-bosses; overlaps RPG Mobs' Elite/Champion/Remnant rank tiers which already make 'big version of a vanilla mob' fights.

name: The Twilight Forest
reason: The classic boss-progression dimension (9 bosses, progression locks) - excellent content, but it competes directly with NightBeam's Eclipsed Realm as the pack's boss dimension. Recommended as a Season 2 chapter or opt-in.
notes: CurseForge-only for NeoForge 1.21.1. Not on Modrinth. Verified from the CF jar twilightforest-1.21.1-4.8.3345-universal.jar (sha1 9cfd4154928433e2f1f6cfc3deb48c284debb580). twilightforest:plateau_boss is in its boss tag but is the final-plateau placeholder.

name: THE UNDEAD REVAMPED
reason: 41 new undead types; on-tone but small project (205k MR) self-described as unfinished, and undead variety is already covered by Born in Chaos and The Graveyard.

name: Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks
reason: Best-in-class spellbook mage with strong content (Dead King, Tyros, Citadel, Catacombs), but it would be another casting system and mana bar next to Runeborn (12 spells on FP via staves/seals) and NightBeam's own Skills and Powers (optional in the NightBeam audit; 30 abilities on Essence in six schools that mirror Iron's). Optional 'Arcanist' module only, and never together with Skills and Powers.
conflicts: Spell schools and mana duplicate Skills and Powers (Pyromancy/Stormcalling/Tidecalling ~ fire/lightning/ice) and Runeborn FP spells.

name: Shield Expansion
reason: Adds shield tiers, Off-Guard cooldown and timed parries, the one soulslike verb Runeborn lacks. Off by default so the pack ships one combat ruleset; enable only after testing against Runeborn's stamina/poise.
conflicts: Its author recommends pairing with Combat Roll (which this pack excludes). Changes vanilla shield behaviour; Fellowship's Bulwark fights sword-and-shield, so test that allies still block correctly.

name: Simply Swords
reason: Popular unique/legendary weapons with BC animations (429 weapon_attributes). Runeborn already provides 74 armaments in 19 classes (katanas, twinblades, greatswords...) with tempering/affinities, so a second weapon catalogue is duplication; Runeborn would scale them via vanillaWeaponsScale if enabled.
conflicts: Weapon-class overlap with Runeborn; its gem-socket system parallels Runeborn affinities/tempering.

name: Rechiseled
reason: Lighter chisel alternative with connected textures if builders ask for more blocks.

name: Explorify
reason: Vanilla-style small dungeons; good, but overlaps D&T/Structory/Philip's Ruins - add only if the world feels empty.

name: Incendium Legacy
reason: Nether biome/structure overhaul (Forbidden Castle, Sanctum). Stardust now titles it 'Incendium Legacy' and the only 1.21.x build is 5.4.4, marked ALPHA on Modrinth (2024-12), with the previous build named 'UNSUPPORTED_PORT'. Enable only after a stability test.
conflicts: Not compatible with Amplified Nether (per its page).
notes: Modrinth release channel for the newest NeoForge 1.21.1 build: alpha. Release channel alpha on Modrinth; CurseForge lists the same file as release.

name: Integrated Dungeons and Structures
reason: Integrated Dungeons and Structures: great dark-fantasy dungeons (Labyrinth, Necromancer's Spire, Haunted Manor), BUT its 1.21.1 mods.toml REQUIRES Create, Quark, Supplementaries and Integrated API - only viable if the pack adopts Create.

name: MES - Moog's End Structures
reason: 25 End structures to fill Nullscape's emptiness; optional End content density.

name: Repurposed Structures (NeoForge/Forge)
reason: Biome variants of vanilla structures (107 structure ids); large structure count, overlaps YUNG's and T&T - optional.

name: Structory: Towers
reason: Adds 21 towers/outposts; nice but overlaps Towns and Towers and D&T firewatch towers.
notes: Same multi-version jar naming as Structory.

name: When Dungeons Arise: Seven Seas
reason: Ship/naval dungeons; nice with Aquamirae but adds ocean density - optional.

name: Aquaculture 2
reason: Fishing overhaul with Neptunium gear tier; Neptunium competes with Runeborn armaments and NightBeam's Fisherman's Coast already covers fishing flavour.

name: Cooking for Blockheads
reason: Kitchen multiblock QoL; useful only if the food layer grows.

name: Create
reason: A light Create presence is popular in RPG packs, but it is a 19 MB tech mod with its own progression that pulls focus from a soulslike; only if a 'tinkerer' chapter is wanted (also unlocks IDAS).
notes: Licence: Create Mod License. Modrinth marks the client side optional, but Create registers blocks/items, so it must be on both sides.

name: Create: Bells & Whistles
reason: Create train decor; only with Create.

name: End's Delight
reason: End cooking; only a beta 1.21.1 build.
notes: Modrinth release channel for the newest NeoForge 1.21.1 build: beta. Release channel beta.

name: My Nether's Delight
reason: Nether cooking; nice-to-have.

name: Ocean's Delight
reason: Seafood recipes; small.

name: Dragon Mounts Remastered
reason: Rideable dragons; a flying mount trivialises RPG Mobs' distance-based threat and structure exploration, and the PolyForm-Noncommercial licence needs care. Late-game reward only.

name: Redomesticate
reason: Multiloader fork of Domestication Innovation (pet enchantments, pet beds); small (29k MR) and pets are secondary to Fellowship's companions.

name: Architectury API
reason: Required by Simply Swords and Critters and Companions.

name: Balm
reason: Required by Cooking for Blockheads.

name: Fusion (Connected Textures)
reason: Client-side connected textures, required by Rechiseled.

name: Fzzy Config
reason: Required by Simply Swords; requires Kotlin for Forge.

name: GlitchCore
reason: Optional dependency of Serene Seasons (Modrinth lists it required).
notes: Modrinth release channel for the newest NeoForge 1.21.1 build: beta.

name: Integrated API
reason: Required by IDAS only.

name: Iron's Lib
reason: Required by Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks (range [1.21.1-2,1.21.1-3)).

name: Kotlin for Forge
reason: Required by Fzzy Config (Simply Swords). Fragmentum already jar-in-jars KFF 5.3.0; add the standalone 5.12.0 only if Simply Swords is enabled.

name: Moog's Structure Lib (moogs_structures)
reason: Required by Moog's structure packs (MES).

name: Quark
reason: Required by IDAS 1.21.1 only (large vanilla+ mod; would need its own config pass).

name: Simply Tooltips
reason: Client-side tooltip library required by Simply Swords.

name: SuperMartijn642's Config Lib
reason: Required by Rechiseled.

name: SuperMartijn642's Core Lib
reason: Required by Rechiseled.

name: YetAnotherConfigLib
reason: Config lib used optionally by Friends&Foes / It Takes a Pillage and required by Critters and Companions; already jar-in-jar inside Fragmentum (3.6.6).

name: Zeta
reason: Required by Quark.

name: Relics
reason: Levelling relic accessories with their own research/XP system; parallel progression, and the word 'relic' already means Sovereign drops in Runeborn.

name: Enhanced Celestials
reason: Blood Moon duplicates NightBeam RPG Mobs' Hunter's Moon (which already doubles rank chances); two lunar-event systems would stack spawns and confuse players.

name: Alex's Caves (Unofficial Port)
reason: Official Alex's Caves stops at 1.20.1; the 1.21.1 build is an unofficial port on a ported Citadel - too risky for a flagship pack.

name: Alex's Mobs (Unofficial Port)
reason: Alex's Mobs (Unofficial Port): community port, last update 2026-01-26, needs a separate Citadel port; 90+ animals is bloat next to Naturalist and the bosses layer.

name: Alex's Mobs Continued
reason: Second, actively updated port (2026-10-19) on CodxLib; same bloat argument. Prefer this over the other port if fauna is ever expanded.

name: Enemy Expansion

name: Archers (RPG Series)
reason: RPG Series class on Spell Engine; ranged skills duplicate Skills and Powers and Fellowship's Ranger; brings ranged-weapon-api.

name: Ars Nouveau
reason: Whimsical glyph-crafting magic with automation; wrong tone and a fourth magic system next to Runeborn and Skills and Powers.

name: Goety - The Dark Arts
reason: Necromancy/dark-arts magic system - on-tone but a full extra magic/progression system (needs Patchouli).

name: Jewelry (RPG Series)
reason: RPG Series rings/necklaces built around spell_power attributes that do nothing without Spell Engine classes; Artifacts covers accessory loot better.

name: Paladins & Priests (RPG Series)

reason: RPG Series class on Spell Engine; duplicates Runeborn's Dexterity/Strength armament paths.

name: Spell Engine
reason: Casting framework for the RPG Series; only needed if those classes were taken.

name: Wizards (RPG Series)
reason: RPG Series class on Spell Engine (NeoForge 1.21.1 build exists, 3.1.3). Spell Engine is another casting/class layer duplicating Runeborn origins and Skills and Powers schools; pulls 4+ extra libraries.

name: Combat Roll
reason: Duplicates Runeborn's dodge roll (Left Alt, i-frames), and its default key R collides with Runeborn's weapon art (R) and Skills and Powers cast slot 1 (R).

name: Epic Fight
reason: Replaces the whole combat/animation model with its own stamina, dodge, guard and skill system: duplicates Runeborn's stamina + dodge roll + weapon arts and is incompatible with Better Combat.
conflicts: Better Combat (hard), Runeborn (stamina/dodge/weapon arts duplicated), most third-person animation mods.

name: Marium's Soulslike Weaponry
reason: No NeoForge 1.21.1 build (Fabric/Forge only; Forge-only jars cannot load on NeoForge). Its Elden-Ring-style boss weapons also duplicate Runeborn's Sovereign relic armaments.
notes: CurseForge project exists, but cfwidget's file list shows no NeoForge 1.21.1 file (its listing is partial for this project); resolve the CF file id in the CurseForge app/API or use the Modrinth file. No NeoForge 1.21.1 build found on Modrinth or CurseForge (2026-10-29).

name: Spartan Weaponry Unofficial
reason: Unofficial community port (108k MR downloads); its weapon classes duplicate Runeborn's armaments.

name: Chipped
reason: ~10k block variants (bloat) plus Athena CTM; Handcrafted + vanilla is enough for a combat-first pack.

name: Amplified Nether
reason: Incompatible with Incendium, heavy on performance, and the brief is vanilla-first.

name: Biomes O' Plenty
reason: New block palette + TerraBlender/GlitchCore; only beta builds for 1.21.1; overlaps Terralith.
notes: Modrinth release channel for the newest NeoForge 1.21.1 build: beta.

name: Formations (Structure Library)
reason: Structure library only needed by Formations content packs, none of which are chosen.

name: MNS - Moog's Nether Structures
reason: Nether filler structures; YUNG's fortresses + Cataclysm/D&T Nether content are enough.

name: MSS - Moog's Soaring Structures
reason: Floating sky structures - off-tone for a grounded dark-fantasy world.

name: MVS - Moog's Voyager Structures
reason: Generic overworld structure spam overlapping D&T/Structory/T&T.

name: Regions Unexplored
reason: Adds a new block/wood palette; conflicts with the vanilla-first brief and doubles Terralith's biome role.

name: The Aether
reason: Bright sky dimension - off-tone, and a second dimension chain next to the Eclipsed Realm.

name: The Undergarden
reason: Dark dimension with bosses but beta-only on 1.21.1 and a third extra dimension next to Otherside + Eclipsed Realm.
notes: Modrinth release channel for the newest NeoForge 1.21.1 build: beta.

name: Waystones
reason: Noted for the QoL researcher: Runeborn Ember Shrines already provide named fast-travel points; Waystones would duplicate it.

name: YUNG's Better Witch Huts
reason: Conflicts with NightBeam's own 'The Witch Hut' (mod id better_witch_huts, display name 'Better Witch Huts', structure better_witch_huts:witch_hut in swamp/dark forest/plains). YUNG's disables vanilla huts by mixin and adds its own; two 'Better Witch Huts' in the same swamps confuses players and quests.
notes: CurseForge project exists, but cfwidget's file list shows no NeoForge 1.21.1 file (its listing is partial for this project); resolve the CF file id in the CurseForge app/API or use the Modrinth file.

name: Croptopia
reason: CurseForge-only NeoForge build; hundreds of crops/foods (item bloat) that duplicate Farmer's Delight.
notes: CurseForge-only for NeoForge 1.21.1.

name: Domestication Innovation
reason: No 1.21.1 build (stops at 1.20.1). Redomesticate is its 1.21.1 fork.
notes: CurseForge project exists, but cfwidget's file list shows no NeoForge 1.21.1 file (its listing is partial for this project); resolve the CF file id in the CurseForge app/API or use the Modrinth file. No NeoForge 1.21.1 build found on Modrinth or CurseForge (2026-10-29).

name: Apotheosis
reason: Affix loot + gems + boss/elite mobs duplicate Runeborn affinities/tempering, NightBeam loot bags and RPG Mobs ranks; Apothic Attributes re-skins the attribute UI that RAS owns.

name: Apothic-Enchanting
reason: Standalone enchanting overhaul (Eterna/Quanta); extra power creep on top of Runeborn's +25 tempering.

name: Obscure API
reason: Old Aquamirae dependency; no NeoForge 1.21.1 build and no longer needed (Aquamirae 7.x uses Fragmentum).
notes: No NeoForge 1.21.1 build found on Modrinth or CurseForge (2026-10-29).
